scope: Checkpoint and implementation-source evidence for state precision; attention-KV startup logging alone does not establish recurrent precision. Backend selection logs are not kernel-execution traces.

mistralrs.flow: Checkpoint mamba_ssm_dtype=float32 resolves in gdn/config.rs, passes through qwen3_5_moe/text.rs into HybridCache, and selects F32 recurrent allocation; convolution uses model BF16 separately. Hashes match the native run source manifest.

vllm.flow: Actual image source audit maps Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration to its config hook, which resolves auto SSM cache dtype from checkpoint mamba_ssm_dtype. Qwen3_5 calls gated_delta_net_state_dtype with that setting; convolution remains model BF16 and recurrent state becomes F32.
